newsitem.title: GREECE: REUTERS HELLAS CHIEF NAMED STRATEGY MANAGER IN LONDON.
newsitem.headline: REUTERS HELLAS CHIEF NAMED STRATEGY MANAGER IN LONDON.

text.p: Bill Cairley, managing director of Reuters Hellas for the past five years, is leaving to take up the new post of Reuters Global Field Operations Strategy Manager based in London.

Cairley, 46, grew Reuters business substantially during his stay, consolidated operations under a single roof at Kolokotroni Square and introduced satellite technology to improve quality of financial news and information for some 400 clients in Greece.

He will take up his post at the London headquarters of the international news and information company by June. He will work with field operations teams to introduce best practices and efficiency changes.

"Living and working in Greece has been both a privilege and a pleasure," Cairley said in a news release. "I am very proud to have been a small part of the process of change in the financial and news community in the country."

Cairley added: "During five of the most enjoyable years of my life, I have seen several exciting improvements and made many wonderful, long lasting friendships. I take with me many happy memories of my time in my Greek home."
His successor will be announced in about two weeks. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
